blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection, but dense frame-level inference makes them impractical for real-time deployment. Existing acceleration commonly relies on uniform sampling, which ignores content dynamics and can either waste computation on static segments or miss localized anomalies. We propose MoG-VLM a motion-adaptive anomaly detection framework that leverages motion purely as a lightweight control signal to decide when VLM inference is necessary. To this end, we introduce Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) which performs content-aware sampling to concentrate computation on informative regions while avoiding redundant processing. We further introduce a hierarchical dual-stream design in which dense multi-frame VLM reasoning is activated only around frames with elevated anomaly likelihood, via anchor-triggered context-window expansion with early termination. A fusion module then reconciles these instantaneous semantic cues with temporal action dynamics. Across four benchmarks, our method achieves 91.91%, 84.30%, 87.88%, and 78.96% AUC-ROC on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, MSAD, and ShanghaiTech, respectively, establishing new state of the art on three benchmarks under the zero-shot, training-free setting. On XD-Violence, we improve over the previous best result by +0.57% while delivering a 1.31x inference speedup. These results demonstrate that content-aware allocation of VLM capacity, processing fewer frames more intelligently rather than all frames uniformly, is a more effective axis of progress than uniformly densifying VLM inference across frames. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/kdawoud91/MoG-VLM.
blocks.zh: Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)已经显示出强大的视频异常探测潜力,但密集的帧级推论使得它们对于实时部署不切实际. 现有的加速通常依靠统一的取样,这种取样忽略了内容动态,可以浪费在静态片段上的计算,也可以错过局部异常. 我们提议MoG-VLM一个运动适应异常检测框架,利用运动纯粹作为轻量级控制信号来决定何时需要VLM推论. 为此,我们引入了进行内容意识取样的Temperal Gradient Magnitude(TGM),以集中计算信息区,同时避免冗余处理. 我们进一步引入了分级双流设计,即密集的多帧VLM推理仅在有较高异常可能性的帧周围启动,通过锚触上下文窗口扩展,提前终止. 一个聚变模块然后将这些瞬间语义提示与时间动作动态调和. 在四个基准中,我们的方法分别实现了91.91%、84.30%、87.88%和78.96%的AUC-ROC关于XD-暴力、UCF-Crime、SMAD和上海科技,在零射线、无培训设置下的三个基准上建立了新的技术水平。 在XD-暴力方面,我们比以往的最佳结果提高0.57%,同时提供1.31x推论速度。 这些结果表明,对VLM容量的内容认识分配,比对所有帧的处理更加智能化,而不是所有帧的统一,是比对跨帧的VLM推论进行统一分解更有效的进展轴. 代码可见于GitHub:https://github.com/kdawoud91/MoG-VLM.

blocks.en: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The proliferation of camera systems has generated unprecedented volumes of video data, creating an urgent need for automated anomaly detection systems capable of identifying rare and unpredictable events in real-time [ 21 , 6 ] .
Traditional approaches [ 6 , 36 , 12 ] that process every frame with equal computational intensity or uniform stride are fundamentally misaligned with the nature of video footage, where anomalous events are sparse and localized. This inefficiency becomes particularly pronounced when deploying computationally expensive Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which offer unprecedented semantic understanding but impose prohibitive inference costs for continuous real-time processing [ 11 , 3 ] .
Modern video-capable architectures such as Video-LLaMA [ 37 ] and the Qwen-VL family [ 3 ] demonstrate remarkable improvements in temporal coherence and semantic depth compared to earlier contrastive models [ 18 , 2 ] , making them particularly well-suited for
applications where abnormality is often defined by context. However, this representational power comes at a substantial computational cost. Without mechanisms to adapt inference effort to content dynamics in video anomaly detection (VAD), this representational power remains largely inaccessible under the computational and memory constraints of real-time deployment [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh:
相机系统的扩散产生了前所未有的视频数据量,因此迫切需要自动异常探测系统,能够实时识别罕见和不可预测的事件[21,6].
传统方法[6,36,12],以相同的计算强度或统一速度处理每个帧,从根本上与视频镜头的性质错位,异常事件稀少,局部化. 在部署计算昂贵的VLM-语言模型(VLMs)时,这种低效率变得特别明显,这些模型提供了前所未有的语义理解,但对持续的实时处理造成了令人望而却步的推论成本[11,3].
Video-LLaMA[37]和Quen-VL家族[3]等现代视频能力架构,与早期对比模型[18,2]相比,在时间一致性和语义深度方面表现出显著的改善,使其特别适合.
通常由上下文定义异常的应用程序。 然而,这种代表权力的计算成本很高。 在视频异常探测(VAD)中,如果没有适应内容动态的推论努力机制,这种代表力在实时部署的计算和内存限制下仍然基本无法使用[36].

blocks.en: Current VLM-based anomaly detection methods overwhelmingly adopt uniform processing paradigms, sampling frames at fixed strides [ 36 , 12 , 35 ] or analyzing entire videos exhaustively [ 20 ] regardless of content dynamics. This is wasteful: many video intervals are static or low-activity yet incur the same per-frame VLM cost as dynamic, anomaly-rich segments. Recent zero-shot extensions [ 36 , 12 ] and parameter-efficient fine-tuning approaches [ 35 , 34 ] have advanced reasoning quality, but inherit this uniform-sampling assumption and overlook the spatial and temporal sparsity inherent to surveillance footage.
blocks.zh: 目前基于VLM的异常检测方法绝大多数采用统一的处理范式,在固定速度[36,12,35]时采用取样框架,或详尽分析整个视频[20],无论内容动态如何。 这是浪费的:许多视频间隔是静态的或低活性的,但每帧的VLM成本与动态的,异常丰富的片段相同. 近期的零镜头扩展[36,12]和参数高效的微调方法[35,34]具有先进的推理质量,但继承了这种统一的抽样假设,忽略了监视片段固有的空间和时空伸缩.

blocks.en: In contrast, our framework operates from a deliberately coarse baseline sampling rate and selectively densifies only where motion dynamics indicate informative content. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , dense (Fig. 1 a) and uniform (Fig. 1 b) sampling process frames indiscriminately, while our motion-adaptive approach (Fig. 1 c-d) concentrates computation on temporally dynamic segments intervals exhibiting high or sudden motion changes characteristic of fights, explosions, or vehicle collisions and suppresses redundant inference on static footage.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,我们的框架是根据一个刻意粗糙的基线取样率运作的,并且只有在运动动态表明内容丰富的情况下,才有选择地变质。 如图1所示,密集(图1a)和统一(图1b)的取样过程框不分青红皂白,而我们的运动适应方法(图1c-d)则集中计算时间动态段间隔,显示战斗、爆炸或车辆碰撞的高度或突然运动变化特征,并抑制对静态镜头的多余推论。

blocks.en: This gap between semantic capability and computational tractability motivates a fundamental question: Starting from a coarse uniform sampling baseline, can we adaptively allocate additional computation only when video dynamics demand it to achieve real-time VLM-based anomaly detection? Addressing this question requires moving beyond accuracy-centric evaluation toward a holistic framework that explicitly balances detection performance with computational efficiency. Specifically, there exists no prior work that systematically investigates adaptive mechanisms for content-aware resource allocation in vision-language-based anomaly detection, nor sufficient analysis of the trade-offs between computational cost and video anomaly detection performance.
blocks.zh: 语义能力和可计算性之间的这一差距引发了一个根本问题: 从粗糙的统一采样基线开始,我们能否适应性地分配额外的计算,只有在视频动态要求它实现实时基于VLM的异常检测时才能进行? 要解决这一问题,就必须超越以准确性为中心的评价,转向一个整体框架,明确兼顾检测业绩和计算效率。 具体地说,在基于视觉语言的异常探测中,不存在系统调查内容意识资源分配适应机制的前期工作,也没有对计算成本和视频异常探测性能之间的权衡进行充分分析。

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce a motion-adaptive anomaly detection framework that fundamentally reimagines how computational resources are allocated across video content. Unlike classical approaches that employ motion as a direct classification feature [ 7 , 19 , 17 , 8 ] , we take advantage of motion purely as a lightweight control mechanism, a semantic activation signal that determines when VLM inference is necessary. We introduce TGM analysis to establish a motion quantification mechanism, thereby dynamically adjusting the sampling density based on detected temporal dynamics.
We further introduce an anchor-triggered hierarchical refinement mechanism that preserves computational efficiency while recovering fine-grained temporal context. Adaptively sampled frames that exhibit high anomaly confidence serve as anchor points, triggering progressive multi-window analysis, ensuring that dense coverage is applied exclusively where anomalous patterns emerge.
In parallel, we introduce a complementary temporal stream that captures action dynamics through video-language modeling. This branch processes non-overlapping temporal windows, generating video-level semantic descriptions that encode motion trajectories and behavioral sequences.
The two pathways converge through adaptive scoring, combining frame-level instantaneous detections with temporal-level behavioral context into unified predictions.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们引入了一个运动适应异常检测框架,这个框架从根本上重新设想了计算资源如何在视频内容中分配。 与采用运动作为直接分类特征的古典方法[7,19,17,8]不同,我们利用运动纯粹作为轻量级控制机制,语义激活信号来确定何时需要VLM推断. 我们采用TGM分析来建立运动量化机制,从而根据检测到的时间动态动态动态来动态调整采样密度.
我们进一步引入了锚-触发的等级完善机制,在恢复精细的时间背景的同时,保持计算效率。 具有高度反常信心的适应性抽样框架充当了锚点,触发了渐进式多窗口分析,确保集中覆盖仅限于出现异常模式的地方。
与此同时,我们引入了一个补充时间流,通过视频语言建模来捕捉动作动态. 这个分支处理非重叠时间窗口,生成视频级别的语义描述,编码运动轨迹和行为序列.
两条路径通过适应性评分汇合,将帧级瞬间检测与时间级行为上下文结合为统一预测.

blocks.en: Contributions. We summarize our key contributions as follows: Motion-Adaptive Sampling Framework: A novel motion quantification mechanism using multiscale TGM analysis and adaptive z-score that dynamically adjusts sampling density based on temporal dynamics, achieving substantial computational savings. Anchor-Triggered Hierarchical Refinement: A progressive multi-window expansion mechanism where adaptively sampled frames exhibiting high anomaly trigger conditional retrospective analysis, examining preceding context with early termination to prevent unnecessary computation on low-confidence detections. Tier-Aware Adaptive Fusion: A fusion mechanism in which the mixing weight λ between frame-level and temporal-level streams is not learned but inherited from the TGM motion tier of each frame, with λ taking a piecewise-constant value determined by whether the frame is unflagged, motion-flagged, or anchor-triggered. This tier-driven weighting is agnostic to dataset specifics and scene dynamics. Comprehensive Efficiency-Accuracy Analysis: A systematic study of the compute-accuracy trade-off in zero-shot VLM-based anomaly detection, a dimension largely absent from prior work. MoG-VLM attains 84.30%, 91.91%, 87.88% and 78.96% AUC-ROC on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, MSAD and Shang setting a new zero-shot training-free state of the art on three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 我们总结了我们的主要贡献如下: 采用多尺度的TGM分析和适应性z-分数的新运动量化机制,根据时间动态动态动态动态动态地动态调整采样密度,实现大量计算节约. Anchor-Triggered 等级优化 : 一种渐进的多窗口扩展机制,其适应性取样的帧显示高度异常,引发有条件的回溯分析,审查先前的上下文并及早终止,以防止在低自信检测上进行不必要的计算. 分级智能适应融合 : 一种聚变机制,其中帧级和时间级流之间的混合重量QQ没有学到,而是从每个帧的TGM运动级中继承下来,QQ取一个片断-恒定值,由帧是未悬挂,运动-悬挂,还是锚定-触发决定. 这种层次驱动的权重对数据集的特异性和场景动态具有不可知性. 综合效率准确性分析: 系统研究在基于VLM的零射线异常探测中计算准确性权衡,这个维度基本上没有出现在之前的工作上. 关于UCF-犯罪、XD-暴力、MSAD和Shang的AUC-ROC达到84.30%、91.91%、87.88%和78.96%,在三个基准上设定了新的零射线无训练状态。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Video anomaly detection (VAD) aims to temporally localise frames containing events that deviate from expected behaviour. Early supervised methods required frame-level annotations [ 21 ] , while weakly-supervised formulations reduced the annotation burden to video-level labels through multiple-instance learning (MIL) [ 21 , 4 , 26 , 27 , 25 ] . The emergence of large vision–language models (VLMs) and large language models (LLMs) has opened a new paradigm for VAD by inferring anomaly scores from natural-language scene descriptions at test time, without gradient-based training. LAVAD [ 36 ] pioneered this direction by captioning each frame with a frozen VLM, summarising temporal windows with an LLM, and refining anomaly scores through cross-modal similarity. Despite strong results, its uniform processing of every sampled frame regardless of scene content leads to 71.4 GPU-hours on the XD-Violence test set alone, allocating identical computation to static backgrounds and fast-evolving anomalous events alike. Subsequent work has focused on reasoning quality rather than efficiency. Unified-reasoning [ 12 ] introduces a score-based gate that triggers a second LLM pass with automatically extracted anomaly-tag priors for ambiguous videos, raising AUC-ROC to 84.28% on UCF-Crime and 91.34% on XD. Yet the underlying sampling stays content-blind, a fixed stride of 16 frames is applied uniformly, expending VLM inference on static footage
regardless of scene dynamics.
Other VLM-based methods relax the strictly zero-shot constraint. VERA [ 35 ] steers a frozen VLM with verbalized guiding questions optimised from labelled data, without modifying model weights, though the prompt optimisation itself requires an annotated training set. Holmes-VAU [ 38 ] and Hawk [ 22 ] instruction-tune multimodal LLMs on anomaly clips to produce rich explanations, but they remain tied to seen anomaly types and incur high annotation costs. STPrompt [ 30 ] learns spatio-temporal prompts under weak class-level supervision. AnyAnomaly [ 1 ] proposes customisable VAD by casting detection as context-aware visual question answering with a frozen LVLM, and EventVAD [ 20 ] combines graph architectures with multimodal LLMs through temporal reasoning.
The literature has overwhelmingly prioritised detection accuracy [ 1 , 20 , 39 ] over computational efficiency, leaving the deployment feasibility of
VLM-based VAD unclear. Among the methods discussed above, only Unified [ 12 ] reports timing information. This gap is significant: real-world video systems must process hours of continuous footage, and the practical feasibility of VLM-based anomaly detection depends critically on throughput, not solely on AUC-ROC.
The principle of allocating computation only where content demands it has a long history in video understanding. In action recognition, AdaFrame [ 32 ] trains a policy network to adaptively select informative frames, SCSampler [ 10 ] routes only salient clips to a heavy 3D backbone, AR-Net [ 15 ] learns per-frame resolution selection, FrameExit [ 9 ] conditions early-exit decisions on intermediate features, and LiteEval [ 31 ] alternates between a coarse and fine network via a gating module. The shared design pattern is a two-stage architecture: a cheap first pass produces a saliency signal, and a more expensive pass is activated selectively.
Our framework inherits this two-stage philosophy but differs in three respects. First, our gating mechanism is entirely training-free, we threshold a multiscale Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) via adaptive z-scores, requiring no learned parameters, whereas the methods above learn sampling policies from labelled data, an impractical requirement in anomaly detection where positive examples are scarce. Second, we target untrimmed footage spanning minutes to hours rather than trimmed classification clips, where the informative-to-static ratio is far more extreme. Third, motion serves purely as a control signal that decides when VLM inference is invoked, it does not enter the anomaly score itself, avoiding the conflation of motion salience with anomaly likelihood.
blocks.zh:
视频异常检测(VAD)旨在将包含偏离预期行为的事件的帧时间定位. 早期被监督的方法需要帧级说明[21],而弱监督的配方则通过多层学习(MIL)将注释负担降低到视频级标签[21,4,26,27,25]. 大型视觉-语言模型(VLMs)和大型语言模型(LLMs)的出现为VAD开创了一个新的范式,在测试时从自然语言场景描述中推断出异常分数,而没有基于梯度的训练. LAVAD [36] 开创了这个方向,用冷冻的VLM对每个帧进行字幕,用LLM对时间窗口进行总结,并通过跨模式相似性来精炼异常分数. 尽管取得了显著成果,但无论场景内容如何,它统一处理每个抽样框架,导致光是XD-暴力测试集就达到71.4 GPU小时,将相同的计算分配给静态背景和快速演变的异常事件。 随后的工作侧重于推理质量而不是效率. 统一理由 [12] 引入基于分数的门,触发第二个LLM通过,自动提取异常标前缀用于模糊的视频,将UCF-Crime上的AUC-ROC提高到84.28%,XD上的91.34%. 然而,基本的取样仍为内容失明,16帧的固定速度得到统一应用,将VLM推论用在静态镜头上
无论场景动态如何
其他基于VLM的方法放松了严格零射的制约. VERA [35] 引导一个冷冻的VLM,用标注数据优化的口头指导问题,不修改模型权重,尽管快速优化本身需要附加说明的训练集. Holmes-VAU [38] 和Hawk [22] 指示调用异常片段的多模式LLMs,以产生丰富的解释,但它们仍然与所见异常类型联系在一起,并产生高昂的注释成本. STPrompt [30] 在薄弱的班级监管下,学习斯皮提奥-时速提示. Anomaly [1] 提出可自定义的 VAD,通过铸造检测作为上下文感视觉问题回答,用冷冻的 LVLM [20] 通过时间推理将图架构与多式联运LLMs结合.
文献绝大多数都把检测准确性[1、20、39]置于计算效率的优先地位,使部署
基于 VLM 的 VAD 不清楚 。 在以上讨论的方法中,只有统一[12]报告时间安排信息。 这一差距很大:现实世界的视频系统必须处理连续镜头的时数,基于VLM的异常探测的实际可行性主要取决于吞吐量,而不仅仅是AUC-ROC.
只有在内容需要时才分配计算的原则在视频理解方面有着悠久的历史. 在行动识别方面,AdaFrame [32] 培训一个政策网络,以适应性地选择信息框架,SCSampler [10] 仅将突出的片段通往一个重的3D主干线,AR-Net [15] 学习每个片段的分辨率选择,FrameExit [9] 条件对中间特性的提前退出决定,LiteEval [31] 通过一个Gating模块在粗糙和精细的网络之间替代. 共享设计模式为两阶段建筑:廉价的首发传球产生显要信号,更昂贵的传球被选择性地激活.
我们的框架继承了这一两阶段的哲学,但在三个方面有所不同。 首先,我们的测量机制是完全没有训练的,我们通过适应性的z分数来设定一个多尺度的TGM梯度(TGM),不需要学习的参数,而上面的方法从标有标记的数据中学习采样政策,这是在正例很少的地方进行异常检测时不切实际的要求. 其次,我们把未经剪辑的镜头设定在数分钟到数小时之间,而不是剪切的分类片段,其中信息-静态比要极端得多。 第三,运动纯粹是一种控制信号,它决定何时引用VLM推论,它不会进入异常分数本身,避免了运动的显著性与异常概率的混淆.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the MoG-VLM framework. Motion-adaptive sampling via TGM categorizes frames into three tiers: baseline uniform (orange), TGM-triggered densification (green), and anchor-triggered (magenta). Baseline stride frames and TGM-triggered frames with high anomaly scores become anchors, initiating hierarchical lookback windows ( W 1 W_{1} , W 2 W_{2} , W 3 W_{3} ). Stream B conducts temporal-level Video-VLM multi-frame reasoning and LLM scoring. Tier-aware adaptive fusion combines both streams using motion-tier-inherited weights ( λ base \lambda_{\text{base}} , λ motion \lambda_{\text{motion}} , λ anchor \lambda_{\text{anchor}} ) without training.
blocks.zh: 图2 性别与语言部框架概述。 通过TGM进行运动适应性取样,将框架分为三个层次:基线统一(橙色),TGM触发密度(绿色)和锚-触发(magenta). 基线悬浮帧和反常分数较高的TGM触发帧成为锚,启动分级回望窗口(W 1 W_{1},W 2 W_{2},W 3 W_{3}). Stream B进行时间级的视频-VLM多帧推理和LLM评分. 两级意识的适应性聚变结合了两条溪流,使用运动层次的继承权重( 基\lambda_{\text{base}},λ基/lambda_{\text{motion}},λ基/lambda_{\text{annchor}}),不经过训练.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our framework introduces motion-adaptive sampling with hierarchical VLM-based processing through a dual-stream architecture that balances computational efficiency with detection accuracy. Fig. 2 illustrates the complete pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架通过一种双流结构,在计算效率与检测精度之间取得平衡,引入了具有分级VLM处理的运动适应性取样。 图2说明了整个管道的情况。

blocks.en: 3.1 Frame-Level Anomaly Detection via Motion-Adaptive Sampling
blocks.zh: 3.1 通过动向分析取样进行框架级异常检测

blocks.en: We propose a motion-adaptive sampling strategy that dynamically adjusts processing density based on temporal dynamics, enabling efficient allocation of computational resources to informative regions while maintaining detection accuracy.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Temporal Gradient Magnitude Analysis

blocks.en: 3.4 Anchor-Triggered Multi-Frame Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 锁定式多纤维分析

blocks.en: While the frame-level analysis provides efficient anomaly detection through motion-adaptive sampling at an elevated rate r high r_{\text{high}} in dynamic regions, certain anomalous activities require even denser temporal coverage to fully capture their fine-grained dynamics. Rather than indiscriminately escalating the sampling rate across all dynamic segments, we introduce an anchor-triggered multi-window mechanism that selectively activates dense multi-frame processing only around adaptively sampled frames that exhibit high anomaly likelihood.

blocks.en: 3.5 Temporal-Level Anomaly Detection via Multi-Frame Context
blocks.zh: 3.5 通过多窗体环境进行时间-水平异常检测

blocks.en: While frame-level analysis captures fine-grained semantic understanding of individual moments, many anomalous activities exhibit temporal dependencies spanning multiple frames. To capture these dynamics, we introduce a complementary temporal-level stream that processes multi-frame sequences through a video-language model.
blocks.zh: 虽然帧级分析能捕捉到细微的语义对单个时刻的理解,但许多异常活动显示出跨越多个帧的时间依赖性. 为了捕捉这些动态,我们引入了一个互补的时间级流,通过视频语言模型处理多帧序列.

blocks.en: 3.5.1 Temporal Window Construction
blocks.zh: 3.5.1 临时窗口建设

blocks.en: We construct temporal windows at regular intervals along the video to capture local motion patterns and activity evolution. For a video sequence V = { I t } t = 1 T V=\{I_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} , target frames are selected at a stride s s , and around each target t target ( i ) t_{\text{target}}^{(i)} we form a window 𝒲 i \mathcal{W}_{i} of duration 2 ​ ω 2\omega seconds by sampling n frames n_{\text{frames}} frames: 𝒲 i = { I t j ( i ) } j = 1 n frames , t j ( i ) ∈ [ t target ( i ) − ω , t target ( i ) + ω ] , \mathcal{W}_{i}=\left\{I_{t_{j}^{(i)}}\right\}_{j=1}^{n_{\text{frames}}},\quad t_{j}^{(i)}\in\left[t_{\text{target}}^{(i)}-\omega,\;t_{\text{target}}^{(i)}+\omega\right], (9) where the n frames n_{\text{frames}} sample positions are spaced across the interval. This ensures the video-language model receives a fixed-size input that spans the full window duration.
3.5.2 Video-Language Temporal Captioning and Scoring
blocks.zh: 3.5.2 视频语言时间说明和分镜

blocks.en: For each window 𝒲 i \mathcal{W}_{i} , we employ a video-language model that incorporates spatio-temporal attention to capture motion patterns, action progressions, and inter-frame dependencies across the sequence. The temporal caption is generated as: c i temporal = ℱ VideoLLM ​ ( 𝒲 i , 𝒫 temporal ) , c_{i}^{\text{temporal}}=\mathcal{F}_{\text{VideoLLM}}(\mathcal{W}_{i};\,\mathcal{P}_{\text{temporal}}), (10) where ℱ VideoLLM \mathcal{F}_{\text{VideoLLM}} denotes the video-language model and 𝒫 temporal \mathcal{P}_{\text{temporal}} is a prompt template designed to elicit descriptions of activities, motion dynamics, and behavioral patterns. (see Supplementary C.3.3 for the full prompts). Motion-Adaptive Sampling. We extract frames at a baseline rate of 1 FPS to establish coarse temporal coverage. For TGM computation, we employ multiscale temporal analysis with window sizes 𝒲 = { 1 , 2 , 4 } \mathcal{W}=\{1,2,4\} frames to capture motion patterns at different temporal scales. Adaptive z-score anomaly detection uses an exponential moving average (EMA) decay factor of α = 0.95 \alpha=0.95 for baseline statistics tracking, with anomaly threshold θ anom = 2.3 \theta_{\text{anom}}=2.3 standard deviations.
When motion anomalies are detected, we increase sampling density to r high = 3 r_{\text{high}}=3 FPS within a temporal window of Δ ​ t = 1 \Delta t=1 seconds around the detected frame. Vision-Language Models. We employ Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for frame-level captioning and VideoLLaMA3-7B for temporal-level processing, where each input consists of n frames = 10 n_{\text{frames}}=10 frames uniformly sampled from a non-overlapping 64-frame window at the video frame rate. Language-Based Anomaly Scoring. For both frame-level and temporal-level, we employ Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. The scoring prompts employ chain-of-thought reasoning, instructing the model to first analyze the caption content, then assess anomaly likelihood on a scale from 0 (completely normal) to 1 (highly anomalous).
Run-to-run AUC variation across three reruns remains below 0.20% on all benchmarks (variance attributable to LLM temperature sampling). Anchor-Triggered Multi-Frame Analysis. When a frame’s anomaly score exceeds θ trigger = 0.5 \theta_{\text{trigger}}{=}0.5 , we initiate hierarchical lookback windows of [ t i − 5 , t i ) [t_{i}{-}5,t_{i}) , [ t i − 15 , t i − 5 ) [t_{i}{-}15,t_{i}{-}5) , and [ t i − 30 , t i − 15 ) [t_{i}{-}30,t_{i}{-}15) frames at dense FPS. Progressive expansion to each subsequent window is conditioned on the preceding window’s mean score exceeding θ trigger \theta_{\text{trigger}} .
For tier-aware fusion (Eq. 13 ), we set λ base = 0.3 \lambda_{\text{base}}=0.3 , λ motion = 0.4 \lambda_{\text{motion}}=0.4 , and λ anchor = 0.7 \lambda_{\text{anchor}}=0.7 across all datasets. These values reflect a monotonically increasing trust in the frame-level stream as the sampling tier rises.
We smooth λ t \lambda_{t} with a 1-D Gaussian ( σ λ = 0.25 \sigma_{\lambda}=0.25 s) and clip to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] before applying Eq. 12 to avoid discontinuities at tier boundaries. The fused score s ~ t \tilde{s}_{t} is then post-processed with a second 1-D Gaussian filter ( σ = 1.0 \sigma=1.0 s) for evaluation stability.

Motion-adaptive sampling (TGM). The TGM gate improves AUC-ROC by + 0.69 % +0.69\% to + 3.29 % +3.29\% across all datasets relative to the uniform baseline. These consistent gains confirm that motion gating successfully concentrates VLM computation on informative intervals without sacrificing detection quality. Anchor-triggered hierarchical refinement. Adding anchor refinement produces strongly dataset-dependent effects. On UCF ( + 1.76 % +1.76\% ), XD ( + 2.6 % +2.6\% ) and MSAD ( + 0.80 % +0.80\% ), hierarchical lookback contributes substantially, as many anomalies in these benchmarks (assault, accidents) unfold over multi-second pre-event contexts that benefit from denser temporal evidence. blocks.en: 4.5 Computational Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 计算效率分析

blocks.en: We report timing across XD, UCF, MSAD and Shang on a single NVIDIA A100 40 GB GPU. Table 3 gives per-component latency, Table 4 traces cumulative timing cost as each stage is activated, and Table 5 compares end-to-end throughput against prior zero-shot training-free methods. Where time is spent. Frame-level VLM captioning dominates at 8.19 s/batch (Qwen3-VL-8B), followed by VideoLLaMA3 at 2.04 s/batch; LLM scoring is negligible (0.64 s/batch). Pipeline cost is therefore governed by how often the visual encoders are invoked. Cost attribution per stage. The 1 FPS uniform baseline consumes 7.96, 3.51, 0.78 and .13 h on XD, UCF, MSAD and Shang. TGM gating adds 6–17%, anchor refinement adds a further 13–26%, and the temporal stream contributes roughly half the frame-stream cost. The final dual configuration totals 14.80, 7.80, 1.62 and .28 h. Throughput. Following the convention of stride-based methods [ 12 ] , we report amortized effective throughput FPS eff = N frames / T pipeline \mathrm{FPS}_{\mathrm{eff}}=N_{\mathrm{frames}}/T_{\mathrm{pipeline}} . MoG-VLM reaches 43.84, 36.25, 39.01 and 40.46 FPS, yielding 4.30 4.30 – 4.82 × 4.82\times speedups over LAVAD and 1.17 1.17 – 1.31 × 1.31\times over Unified-reasoning. On XD-Violence, it saves 4.60 h of GPU inference time while improving AUC-ROC by + 0.57 % +0.57\% . Where the savings originate. Three mechanisms: a coarser 1 FPS baseline stride (vs. stride-16 in prior work) nearly halves the candidate pool before any content-aware filtering; TGM gating suppresses VLM inference on static intervals; and anchor expansion triggers denser lookback only when frame-level scores exceed θ trigger \theta_{\mathrm{trigger}} , with early termination.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented MoG-VLM, a zero-shot training-free framework that treats motion as a lightweight control signal governing when VLM inference is invoked.
MoG-VLM sets state of the art on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD, remains competitive on ShanghaiTech, and achieves a speedup over the strongest zero-shot baseline, demonstrating that content-aware allocation of model capacity is a more productive axis of progress than scaling uniform VLM inference.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了MoG-VLM,一个零镜头的无训练框架,它把运动当作一个轻量级的控制信号,在引用VLM推论时加以规范.
MOG-VLM设定UCF-Crime,XD-violence,和MSAD的艺术水平在上海Tech上仍然具有竞争力,并实现了比最强的零射线基线更快的速度,表明对模型容量的内涵感知分配是比缩放统一的VLM推论更有成效的进步轴.

The adaptive z-score in manuscript Eq. 3 maintains running
statistics μ t \mu_{t} and σ t \sigma_{t} via EMA updates. Updating these at
every frame allows sustained anomalous motion to be absorbed into the
baseline: as the EMA tracks elevated TGM values during an ongoing
event, the z-score decays below θ anom \theta_{\text{anom}} and suppresses
motion-gated densification mid-event. We prevent this self-suppression
by freezing μ t \mu_{t} and σ t \sigma_{t} whenever z ⁡ ( t ) > θ anom z(t)>\theta_{\text{anom}} ,
so the reference distribution reflects only normal background dynamics.
Table 12 reports frame-level AUC-ROC with and
without freezing. The mechanism yields consistent gains, largest on
MSAD (+2.01 pp) and UCF-Crime (+1.95 pp) where anomalies unfold over
multi-second intervals, and smaller on XD-Violence (+0.44 pp) where
punctate events (gunshots, explosions) complete before the EMA can
adapt. The mechanism adds no inference cost and no hyperparameters.

Successful Cases: Fig. 6 illustrates two successful detections on MSAD dataset. In Robbery_016, forced entry through a glass door generates sustained high-magnitude motion that continuously identifies the weapon, structural damage, and intruder context, yielding a score of 0.96 that closely tracks the ground-truth anomaly boundary. Traffic_accident_12 presents a semantically anomalous event with comparatively modest motion, a vehicle driven into a retail interior. The score ramps gradually before stabilizing at a high-confidence plateau. Despite the absence of conventional violence cues, the scene-level caption resolves the anomaly through contextual incongruity, a vehicle inside a non-vehicular space, producing a score of

blocks.en: Failure Cases. Fig. 6 shows two failure cases. In Shang_03_0036 , the anomaly is a person walking in circles, a subtle behavioral irregularity that generates indistinguishable from normal pedestrian activity the VLM caption interprets the scene as routine behavior, producing a score of only 0.1. This reflects a known limitation of VLMs in distinguishing trajectory-level semantics from appearance alone, rather than a failure of MOG. In Shang_01_0140 , the VLM correctly perceives a motorcycle in a pedestrian plaza yet assigns a score of only 0.2, as the LLM fails to flag it as anomalous without explicit pedestrian-only context, a limitation of zero-shot semantic grounding rather than visual recognition.

blocks.en: The effectiveness of our motion-adaptive video anomaly detection framework relies on designed prompts that guide the Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to extract relevant information. This section details the specific prompts used at different stages of our pipeline and the rationale behind their design.
blocks.zh: 我们运动适应性视频异常探测框架的有效性依赖于设计来引导视觉语言模型(VLMs)提取相关信息的提示. 本节详述我们管道不同阶段使用的具体提示及其设计的理由。

blocks.en: C.1 Frame-Level Captioning Prompt
blocks.zh: C.1 框架级说明提示

blocks.en: For the frame-level analysis using Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, we employ a structured prompt designed to extract comprehensive scene understanding while maintaining focus on security-relevant elements. The complete prompt is:
blocks.zh: 对于使用Quen/Quen3-VL-8B-Instructionct的帧级分析,我们使用一个结构化的提示,旨在获取全面的场景理解,同时保持对安全相关要素的关注. 完整的提示是:

blocks.en: Frame Captioning Prompt Analyze this surveillance footage frame and provide: 1. SCENE DESCRIPTION: - All people present: their count, positions, activities, and interactions - Any unusual behaviors or events - Objects of interest: bags, weapons, vehicles, or suspicious items - Environmental context: location type (street, pedestrian area, parking lot, etc.), crowd density - Vehicles in pedestrian areas: note any cars, bicycles, skateboards, or carts in pedestrian-only zones - Any safety or security concerns
blocks.zh: 框架说明快速分析这一监视镜头框架,并提供: 1. SCENE DESCRIPION: - 所有在场的人:他们的计数、位置、活动和互动 - 任何不寻常的行为或事件 - 感兴趣的物品:袋、武器、车辆或可疑物品 - 环境背景:地点类型(街道、行人区、停车场等),人群密度 - 行人区的车辆:记任何汽车、自行车、滑板或仅在行人区内的推车 - 任何安全或安保关切

blocks.en: Design Rationale. This prompt is structured to elicit detailed, security-focused descriptions from the VLM through several key design principles:
blocks.zh: 设计原理. 这一提示的编排是为了通过若干关键设计原则从甚高频中得出详细、注重安全的说明:

blocks.en: • Explicit Entity Enumeration: By explicitly requesting ”count, positions, activities, and interactions” for people, we ensure quantitative information that is crucial for anomaly detection (e.g., crowd formation, group behaviors). • Open-Ended Safety Assessment: The final request for ”safety or security concerns” allows the model to identify potential anomalies that may not fit predefined categories, leveraging the VLM’s general knowledge of unsafe situations.
blocks.zh: • 明确实体编号: 通过明确要求为人们“计数、位置、活动和互动”,我们确保了对异常现象检测(如人群形成、群体行为)至关重要的定量信息。 • 不限成员名额安全评估: 最后提出的 " 安全或安全考虑 " 请求使该模式能够利用虚拟LM对不安全情况的一般了解,找出可能不符合预先界定的类别的潜在异常。

blocks.en: Explicit Entity Enumeration: By explicitly requesting ”count, positions, activities, and interactions” for people, we ensure quantitative information that is crucial for anomaly detection (e.g., crowd formation, group behaviors).
blocks.zh: 明确实体编号 : 通过明确要求为人们“计数、位置、活动和互动”,我们确保了对异常现象检测(如人群形成、群体行为)至关重要的定量信息。

blocks.en: Open-Ended Safety Assessment: The final request for ”safety or security concerns” allows the model to identify potential anomalies that may not fit predefined categories, leveraging the VLM’s general knowledge of unsafe situations.

blocks.en: Prompt Considerations.
blocks.zh: 即时考虑.

blocks.en: Zero-Shot Generalization: The prompt avoids dataset-specific terminology, enabling the same prompt to work across different surveillance scenarios (street scenes, campus footage, traffic monitoring) without modification.
blocks.zh: 零射一般化: 提示避免了数据集特定术语,使得同样的提示可以不受修改地跨过不同的监视情景(街道场景,校园镜头,交通监控)工作.

blocks.en: C.2 Frame-Level Anomaly Scoring Prompt
blocks.zh: C.2 框架级异常分解提示

blocks.en: Following the frame captioning stage, we employ Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct as a specialized text-based classifier to determine whether the generated descriptions indicate normal or anomalous behavior. The system prompt is designed to provide clear classification criteria while ensuring robust, independent assessments:
blocks.zh: 在框架字幕阶段之后,我们使用Quen/Quen3-4B-Instruct作为专门的基于文本的分类器,以确定生成的描述是否表示正常或异常的行为. 该系统的及时性旨在提供明确的分类标准,同时确保进行有力、独立的评估:

blocks.en: Anomaly Classification System Prompt You are an expert AI system specialized in video surveillance anomaly detection. Analyze scene descriptions and classify them as NORMAL or ANOMALY. ANOMALY INDICATORS: - Violence: fighting, assault, weapons, threatening behavior - Explosions: fire, smoke, blast effects, debris, damaged structures - Accidents: car collisions, crashes, overturned vehicles - Theft: shoplifting, robbery, stealing, grabbing items and fleeing - Medical emergencies: injuries, falls, people on ground needing help - Suspicious behavior: inappropriate running, chasing, panic, fleeing - Property damage: vandalism, destruction, breaking - Abandoned objects: unattended bags, suspicious packages - Crowd anomalies: panic, stampede, unusual mass movements - Fire or smoke visible - Trespassing in restricted areas NORMAL INDICATORS: - Routine activities: walking, standing, sitting, talking normally - Shopping, browsing, work, recreational activities - Vehicles in designated areas: roads, parking lots, bike lanes - Regular traffic flow - Appropriate social interactions - Empty/quiet scenes with no damage or suspicious objects
blocks.zh: 异常分类系统提示 你是一个专家AI系统 专门进行视频监视异常检测 分析场景描述并将其归类为NORMALY或ANOMALY. 暴力:战斗、攻击、武器、威胁行为 -- -- 爆炸:火、烟、爆炸效应、碎片、损坏的结构 -- -- 事故:汽车碰撞、撞车、翻车 -- -- 盗窃:商店盗窃、抢劫、偷窃、抢夺物品和逃离 -- -- 医疗紧急情况:受伤、摔倒、地面上的人需要帮助 -- -- 可疑行为:不适当的跑路、追逐、恐慌、逃离 -- -- 财产破坏:破坏、破坏、破损 -- -- 被遗弃物体:无人看管的袋、可疑包裹 -- -- 人群异常:恐慌、踩踏、异常的大规模移动 -- -- 火灾或烟雾可见 -- -- 在禁区内的穿越 -- 正常活动:步行、站立、坐、谈话 -- -- 购物、浏览、工作 -- -- 娱乐活动 -- 指定地区的车辆:道路、停车场、自行车道 -- -- 正常的交通流量 -- 适当的社会互动 -- 无损坏或可疑物体的空景

blocks.en: Design Rationale. We provide exhaustive lists of both anomalous and normal behaviors to reduce ambiguity and ensure consistent classification across diverse scenarios, rather than relying on the model’s implicit understanding of ”anomaly.”
blocks.zh: 设计原理. 我们提供了异常和正常行为的详尽清单,以减少模糊性,确保不同情况之间的分类一致,而不是依赖模型对“异常”的隐含理解。 “

blocks.en: Integration with Motion-Adaptive Sampling. This frame-level classification prompt operates on selectively sampled frames identified by our TGM-based motion detection. The design ensures that when expensive VLM inference is triggered by motion, the subsequent classification is both accurate and informative, maximizing the value extracted from each processed frame.
blocks.zh: 与Motion-Adapitive Sampling 集成. 星洲网. 这个帧级的分类速率 是在我们基于TGM的动作检测中 确定的有选择性的样本帧上运作的 该设计确保当昂贵的VLM推论被运动触发时,后续的分类既准确又信息丰富,使从每个处理的框架提取的值最大化.

blocks.en: C.3 Temporal-Level Multi-Frame Captioning Prompt
blocks.zh: C.3 临时多层次说明提示

blocks.en: We employ Video-LLaMA 8B to process non-overlapping temporal windows for capturing action dynamics across multiple frames. The temporal captioning prompt is designed to elicit video-level descriptions that encode motion trajectories and sequential activities.
blocks.zh: 我们使用视频LLAMA 8B用于处理不重叠的时间窗口,以捕捉跨多个帧的动作动态. 时间字幕提示器旨在引导视频级描述,对运动轨迹和顺序活动进行编码.

blocks.en: Temporal Multi-Frame Captioning Prompt Describe the actions, movements, and events visible in this sequence. Specifically identify any suspicious, unusual, or anomalous behavior such as: theft, shoplifting, violence, fighting, accidents, burglary, or other criminal activities.
blocks.zh: 描述此序列中可见的动作、动作和事件。 具体指明任何可疑、不寻常或异常的行为,例如:盗窃、偷窃、暴力、战斗、事故、盗窃或其他犯罪活动。

blocks.en: Design Rationale. This prompt architecture addresses the unique requirements of temporal video understanding:
blocks.zh: 设计原理. 这种迅速的架构解决了时间视频理解的独特要求:

blocks.en: • Motion-Centric Language: The emphasis on ”actions, movements, and events” guides the model to focus on temporal dynamics rather than static scene elements, ensuring descriptions capture the behavioral evolution across frames. • Anomaly-Focused: While maintaining open-ended description capabilities, the explicit listing of suspicious behaviors (theft, violence, fighting, etc.) ensures the model remains vigilant for security-relevant patterns that might be subtle or easily overlooked.
blocks.zh: • 运动-儿科语言: 对“动作、运动和事件”的强调,指导模型侧重于时间动态而不是静态场景要素,确保描述能够捕捉跨框架的行为演变。 • 异常发作: 在保持开放式描述能力的同时,明确列出可疑行为(盗窃、暴力、战斗等),确保模式对可能微妙或容易被忽视的安全相关模式保持警惕。

blocks.en: These carefully designed prompts enable our framework to extract security-relevant information at both frame and temporal levels while maintaining zero-shot generalization across diverse surveillance scenarios.
blocks.zh: 这些经过精心设计的提示使我们的框架能够在时间框架和时间层次上提取与安全有关的信息,同时保持对各种监视情景的零射一般化。

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制

blocks.en: Because TGM operates on raw temporal gradients, abrupt illumination changes (e.g., lights switching on/off) and camera jitter can produce spurious activations that erode efficiency gains. The adaptive EMA baseline ( α = 0.95 \alpha=0.95 ) and z-score normalization absorb gradual drift but cannot distinguish a true motion burst from a global photometric spike within a single window. Our multiscale design ( 𝒲 = { 1 , 2 , 4 } \mathcal{W}=\{1,2,4\} ) partially mitigates this, a brief photometric spike elevates the w = 1 w=1 response but is diluted at w = 2 w=2 and w = 4 w=4 , so the aggregated signal is less likely to exceed the z-score threshold than a sustained physical motion event would.
blocks.zh: 由于TGM在原始时间梯度上运行,突然的照明变化(如灯光切换/关闭)和相机焦急可以产生虚假的激活,侵蚀效率的提高. 适应性EMA基线(α = 0.95\alpha = 0.95)和z-分数正常化吸收了逐渐漂移,但无法区分一个真正的运动从一个单一窗口内的全球光度突起。 我们的多级设计( W = { 1, 2, 4}\ mathcal{ W}=\{1,2,4\})部分缓解了这一点,一个短暂的光度突升提升了w=1 w=1响应,但在w=2 w=2和w=4 w=4时被稀释,因此集合信号比持续物理运动事件更不可能超过z分数阈值.
